# xshield_tag_rules (Data Source)

Tag rules matching a criteria, with the tags each applies.

Tag rules decide the core tag values that segment criteria then select on, so this is where to look when a segment matches fewer assets than expected. Unlike a segment criteria, a rule criteria is stored exactly as written.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xshield_tag_rules" "all" {}

# A segment that matches too few assets usually means a disabled tag rule.
output "disabled_rules" {
  value = [
    for r in data.xshield_tag_rules.all.tag_rules : r.rule_name
    if !r.rule_enabled
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `criteria` (String) Criteria selecting the tag rules. Defaults to every tag rule.
- `max_results` (Number) Stop after this many results. Left unset, every match is read. When a limit truncates the result set, `truncated` is true.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Ids of the matching tag rules, in the same order as the detailed list. Convenient for `for_each`.
- `tag_rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_rules))
- `total` (Number) Total number of tag rules matching the criteria, as reported by the API.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when `max_results` stopped the read before the end of the result set.

<a id="nestedatt--tag_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag_rules`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `matching_assets` (Number) Assets the rule currently matches.
- `on_match` (Map of String) Tags applied to a matching asset.
- `rule_criteria` (String) Criteria deciding which assets the rule tags.
- `rule_description` (String)
- `rule_enabled` (Boolean) A disabled rule is not evaluated.
- `rule_name` (String)
